description: This file defines a React component named OAuthConnectionsPanel for managing OAuth provider connections within a Next.js frontend project. It includes UI elements for connecting to Git providers like GitHub, GitLab, and Bitbucket, displays connection status, and handles OAuth login initiation.

classes.name: ProviderUiState
classes.description: Type defining the UI state for each OAuth provider (connected, busy, errors, timestamp).

classes.name: Pill
classes.description: A React component for displaying status badges with color coding.

classes.name: ProviderIcon
classes.description: A React component rendering SVG icons for different OAuth providers.

classes.name: OAuthConnectionsPanel
classes.description: Main React component that renders the OAuth connection management panel with state handling and UI.

methods.name: getReturnTo
methods.description: Constructs the callback URL for OAuth redirect, based on current window location.

methods.name: OAuthConnectionsPanel
methods.description: Main React functional component for managing OAuth provider connections, handling user interactions, and rendering UI.
